notes.title: Bug fixed 10 July 2024
notes.content:
We have noticed that stacked coin can't be used for pull item correctly, or even display right amount in the game. 

 we rebuild the exchange system, now it can function well, even the coin in inventory has been stacked.
 "destory 10 HP Coin" button now has been change to "destory one HP Coin" button, and can only delete one coin for each time.
 If the "get item" function didn't work well, you didn't see any new item in inventory, and your coin number on topbar already reduced, don't worry about it, try refresh button a few time, and the correct number will be back. (cause by internet lag, we suggest not to click "get item" again to fast each time.)


Thank you for playing this game!
Have a good day.

notes.title: Honey Peach Clicker has released on 8 July!
notes.content:
Here we have some guide about this game,and we hope is helpful.

Item drop:
The only item that drops in this game is the "HP Coin", which can be used to exchange other Collectible items "Pantsu".

First time run the game, you'll get a free HPC straight away.
HP Coin drops every three hours since the game published.
The drop time interval will be extended by half an hour every 42 days past. 
When the drop time interval reach 24 hours, the drop of HP Coin will stop forever after 42 days.


Inventory button:
It will open your browser and jump to your steam inventory page.


After click "Exchange" button (right under the peach):

1. Refresh button & HPC quantity check:
Since the internet lag, the quantity of HPC in your steam inventory may need a few seconds to react correctly on top bar.
If you feel the number shown is wrong, please click the "Refresh button" which beside the "HP Coin quantity display field".

2. Get item button:
If you click on "Get one random item" button, and own at least 3 HP coins,  
the exchange function will be processed, which consume 3 coins from your inventory to pull for 1 random item.
pull cannot be reversed.

"items pack" will be replaced every 21 days, except the Common rarity items in pack, which will be replaced every 42 days.
each "items pack" have: 5 Common items (50%), 4 Rare items (40%), 3 Epic items (9.5%), 2 Lagendary items (0.49%) and only 1 Heirloom item (0.01%). 
new pack will update on 07:00am (UTC) each time.


3. HPC Destory button:
If you click on "destory 10 HPC" button, and eventually click the "yes" button to really confirm the process of destory fuction, 
you will permanently lost AT LEAST 10 HP Coin.
Destory cannot be withdrawn.
So, please just do not click this button, ever.


If you have anything want to say to us, welcome to our discord channel!
